channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Victim, 60, of fatal Rancho Penasquitos bicycle crash ID’d as Yi Zhang
item.description: Authorities Friday publicly identified the 60-year- old man fatally struck by a car while bicycling in Rancho Penasquitos.

item.title: Free ‘Winter Wonderland’ event planned in SE San Diego’s Festival Park
item.description: A "Winter Wonderland" will take over Festival Park in Market Creek Plaza Saturday, giving San Diegans a chance to play in snow and celebrate the season.

item.title: Opinion: Are we really satisfied with life in San Diego?
item.description: It's hard to believe a survey touted by the mayor that shows 76% of residents satisfied with life in San Diego.

item.title: San Diego County Sheriff Kelly Martinez applauds deputy’s conviction
item.description: San Diego County Sheriff Kelly Martinez is applauding Friday's verdict by a federal jury convicting a deputy of using excessive force on a man in pretrial custody.

item.title: Feeling lucky? Record $1 Billion Powerball Jackpot hits Saturday
item.description: The multi-state jackpot, the 14th-largest in U.S. history, has been rolling since Sept. 6—40 drawings without a winner.

item.title: Asylum-seekers try other options in Mexico
item.description: Many migrants who were hoping to reach the U.S. are now stuck in a backlog with Mexico’s refugee agency; others are going home.

item.title: Navy investigation finds Osprey safety issues were allowed to grow for years
item.description: A Navy report revealed that the military failed to address a growing series of issues with the V-22 Osprey aircraft since it took flight almost 20 years ago.

item.title: With trade talks, did SDFC offer clue to ‘Chucky’ Lozano’s future in San Diego?
item.description: SDFC has a big question to answer: what to do with Lozano, the star who was benched following a late-season locker room incident.

item.title: At San Diego fence, U.S. officials tout decreased border crossings, promise bigger crackdown in the country’s interior
item.description: White House border czar Tom Homan and U.S. Customs and Border Protection Commissioner Rodney S. Scott came to San Diego to promise increased efforts against illegal immigration.

item.title: Hanukkah 2025 begins at sundown Sunday with lighting of the first candle
item.description: Hanukkah, the eight-day Jewish festival of lights, begins at sundown on Sunday, Dec. 14, with the lighting of the first candle.
